verdict.rationale: The evidence documents generic payouts to connected accounts (external accounts, payout schedules, instant payouts), but nothing about local-currency payouts, FX conversion handling, or settlement over local bank rails versus wires. Generic payout management is adjacent to this story, not the international capability it asks for, and the only community hint is a single enthusiastic line about paying out internationally, with no detail.

support.subject: As a finance lead, international sellers get paid properly — local-currency payouts, documented FX handling, and settlement to local bank rails rather than expensive wires
